test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Run errands

options.text: To go out to buy or do something
To participate in a race through unfair means
To finish running before the end point
To do something incorrectly or erroneous in haste

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Run errands"** means to go out to buy or do something. (काम के लिए बाहर जाना)
 
 
• **Example: **She spent the afternoon running errands, including picking up groceries and mailing a package.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: To participate in a race through unfair means** (अनुचित साधनों से दौड़ में भाग लेना):
 
 
• **Example:** He was disqualified for trying to participate in the race through unfair means.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To finish running before the end point** (समाप्ति बिंदु से पहले दौड़ खत्म करना):
 
 
• **Example:** Due to exhaustion, she finished running before the end point.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To do something incorrectly or erroneous in haste** (जल्दी में कुछ गलत करना):
 
 
• **Example:** In his rush, he did something incorrectly and made a big mistake.
 
 

Question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. Run errands
